name: Default Data Loader
category_description: AI cluster sub-node (model, memory, tool, parser)
description: Use the Default Data Loader node to load binary data files or JSON data for vector stores[^1] or summarization

parameters.name: Data Format
parameters.description: Displays when you set Type of Data to Binary. Select the file MIME type for your binary data. Set to Automatically Detect by MIME Type if you want n8n to set the data format for you. If you set a specific data format and the incoming file MIME type doesn't match it, the node errors. parameters.name: Metadata
parameters.description: Set the metadata that should accompany the document in the vector store. This is what you match to using the Metadata Filter option when retrieving data using the vector store nodes

parameters.name: notice
parameters.displayName: This will load data from a previous step in the workflow. Example

options.description: Process binary data from previous step in the workflow
